releases.body:
## Pi impact

None. No runtime or tool changes.

## OpenCode impact

npm metadata now carries the `opencode` and `opencode-plugin` keywords, so OpenCode plugin directories that crawl npm (such as OpenDock) can discover and list Shepherd. No runtime changes.

## Shared/engine impact

Packaging assertions now guard both the lockfile identity and the discovery keyword, so release metadata cannot silently drift again.

## Verification

`npm test` — Pi suite (37 scripts) and OpenCode suite (12 scripts): pass.

## Pi impact

None. Packaging metadata only; no runtime or tool changes.

## OpenCode impact

None. Packaging metadata only; no runtime or tool changes.

## Shared/engine impact

`package-lock.json` now carries the renamed `@luminascale/shepherd` identity in both the root name and the root package entry, matching `package.json` after the 0.6.0 rename. Added a packaging assertion so the manifest and lockfile cannot drift again. Note that v0.6.2 was never published to npm — this is the first release through the configured trusted publisher.

## Verification

`npm test` — Pi suite (37 scripts) and OpenCode suite (12 scripts): pass. `npm ci --dry-run`: pass.

## Pi impact

`/shepherd spawn <agent>` now launches a separate, parentless agent tab on the hc/Herdr desktop-app backend instead of nesting a subagent under the caller. The `no_parent` option is also available on the Shepherd tools; the older Herdr TUI accepts and ignores it because every agent there already has its own pane.

## OpenCode impact

`shepherd_spawn` gains the same `no_parent` option. Manual `/shepherd spawn <agent>` now forces it through `manualSpawnArgs`, so the spawned agent is parentless rather than being attached to the OpenCode host terminal. A regression guard in the OpenCode surface suite protects this path.

## Shared/engine impact

No-parent hc launches add `--no-parent`, the caller's `herdr.space` label and a `shepherd.no-parent=true` marker; a launch with no Herdr app space fails with an actionable hint instead of silently creating a subagent. The created-terminal registry records the marker for restart-time reaping. Subagent launch flags and lifecycle semantics are unchanged.

## Verification

`npm test` — Pi suite (37 scripts) and OpenCode suite (12 scripts): pass.

## Pi impact
Fixed the one-time migration notice so it renders in an idle session (`deliverAs: 'followUp'` instead of the default `steer`). README refreshed: centered header, dedicated installation guide, both execution backends documented.

## OpenCode impact
Shares the README/docs refresh and the new package name. The plugin entry, tools, and fieldnotes behavior are unchanged from 0.6.0.

## Shared/engine impact
No runtime changes in 0.6.1 itself. This release completes the rename to `@luminascale/shepherd` and the OpenCode adapter shipped in 0.6.0.

## Verification
`npm test` — Pi suite (36 scripts) and OpenCode suite (12 scripts): 676 PASS.
Child pane footer now shows the spawned agent identity (e.g. 🐑 reviewer), so manually driven agents are recognizable at a glance.
